definitions.gloss: to shut oneself in; to seclude oneself; to withdraw
definitions.explanation: To stay indoors and avoid going out or meeting people. Can describe temporary withdrawal (e.g., staying home on a rainy day) or more serious social withdrawal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉|と}じこもって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed shut up in my room all day.
On rainy days, I stay indoors and read books.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失恋|しつれん}→失恋：04195_shitsuren⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉|と}じこもってしまった。
examples.english: After the breakup, she withdrew into her shell.

notes:
Compound verb from ⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧ (to close) + こもる (to seclude oneself). Intransitive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉|と}じこもる (to shut oneself in one's room)
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉|と}じこもる (to stay shut up at home)
- ⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉|と}じこもる (to withdraw into one's shell — figurative)

USAGE:
Can range from neutral (staying home on a bad-weather day) to serious (social withdrawal associated with ⟦{引|ひ}きこもり→引きこもり：10491_hikikomori⟧). Context determines the tone. The figurative use ⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{閉|と}じこもる describes emotional withdrawal.
